stem_book: A car speeds up with constant magnitude of tangential acceleration in a circular path moving in anticlockwise direction. Which of the following figure represents acceleration of the car? (a) [figure] (b) [figure] (c) [figure] (d) [figure]
key: c (c) — every arrow points inward and tilted forward (anticlockwise)
work: a = a_t (forward, constant) + v²/r (inward, growing): arrows tilt forward and grow more radial/longer each quarter → (c)
